title: 263. Sudoku Solver

examples.explanation: The completed grid meets the row, column, and box rules while keeping all given digits.
With every other cell blanked, the givens still determine the same full solution.

hints: Try digits cell by cell with depth-first search, undoing (backtracking) whenever a cell has no legal digit left.
Track used digits per row, column, and box as bit masks, and always branch on the empty cell with the fewest candidates.
